effect_description_eng:
While you have a level 5 [WarGrowlmon], [Taomon] or [Rapidmon], you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Play 1 [WarGrowlmon] Token (Digimon/Red/6000 DP), 1 [Taomon] Token (Digimon/Yellow/6000 DP), and 1 [Rapidmon] Token (Digimon/Green/6000 DP). This effect can't play tokens with the same names as your Digimon. Then, 1 of your level 5 Digimon gains ＜Alliance＞ twice for the turn and attacks.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 level 5 [WarGrowlmon], [Taomon] or [Rapidmon] from your hand without paying the cost.
